schema.name: Membership
schema.purpose_statement: One person's place in one circle. The hash coordinate is circle_id and the range coordinate is person_id.

field_descriptions.added_at: When this membership was added, RFC 3339.
field_descriptions.added_via: How the member was added: link or manual.
field_descriptions.removed_at: When the member was removed, RFC 3339. Absent while they remain a member.
